name: files
description: Browse, read, write and organize documents; inspect and restore file history.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text (truncated to fit); binary files return size and MIME only.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a text document, keeping its history.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move a file or directory without overwriting an existing item.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Move a file or directory into .trash, preserving its history.

tools.name: history
tools.description: List the last 20 file versions, oldest first; deleted versions are marked.

tools.name: restore
tools.description: Restore a file from a version returned by history.
